title: Eastside Food Bank Q3 distribution
brief: Eastside Food Bank's director, Camille Ferreira, needs a Q3 2026 (July to September) summary for the board and for donors. Pounds of food distributed by category and month. Produce: Jul 41200, Aug 46800, Sep 52300. Dairy: 12400, 13100, 14900. Shelf-stable: 38600, 36900, 40200. Protein: 18900, 20400, 22100. Monthly totals 111100, 117200 and 129500 pounds, which is 357800 for the quarter. Households served: Jul 6840, Aug 7310, Sep 7925. That works out to 16.2, 16.0 and 16.3 pounds per household. Points worth drawing out: September distribution is up 16.6 percent on July while households served grew 15.9 percent, so the amount per household held steady; produce grew fastest, up 26.9 percent from July to September, thanks to the new partnership with three local farms that started on 2026-08-15; shelf-stable dipped in August because of a delayed shipment from the regional network. Open with "Q3 at a glance" for the headline numbers, then "By category" with how distribution changed month by month and the figures with totals, and "What we heard", a short block with two quotes from clients: "The fresh vegetables made it possible to cook for the whole week." (Tuesday client, Eastside pantry) and "Pickup was faster than last time." (Saturday client, Eastside pantry). End with a thank-you to volunteers, who gave 4180 hours this quarter.

edit.request: Add a fourth category, Bakery, with 3200 pounds in July, 3600 in August and 4100 in September, and update the monthly totals and the quarter total to include it.
